heroDescription:
Rooted in shipownership.
Connected to the world of maritime trade.
companyLead: Gate One LTD is a shipowning company with a focus on dry cargo and maritime activities.
companyText: At the centre of our business is an owned dry cargo vessel built in 2014. Our activities connect vessel ownership with cargo transportation, chartering and port agency.
activitiesIntro: Four connected areas of maritime activity.
service1Text: Our own dry cargo vessel is the foundation of Gate One LTD.
service2Text: Dry cargo transportation by sea, taking into account cargo requirements, vessel suitability and voyage conditions.
service3Text: Vessel chartering for an agreed voyage or period. Cargo, timing and commercial terms shape each individual arrangement.
service4Text: Vessel support during port calls, coordinating arrival, the port stay and departure.
vesselTitle: At the heart of our business.
vesselIntro:
A 5,000-tonne dry cargo vessel.
Built in 2014. Owned by Gate One LTD.
outlookTitle: A tangible asset. A long-term view.
outlookText: We see shipownership as a long-term commitment. Our focus is on the vessel, the people around it and the commercial relationships that give every voyage its purpose.
principle1Text: A business built around our own vessel.
principle2Text: Connecting the vessel, cargo and port.
